mediaEntries.mediaTitle: Logo design with peach and fist…

generationInputs.prompt: Flat, colorful logo in pop-art sticker style for 'Fisting ConCiencia'. A cartoon peach with a light skin-toned clenched fist coming out of it like a rocket, surrounded by a very red blooming rose with a stylized brain in its center. Color palette: vibrant pink, neon purple, black, and peach-orange. Typography: rounded, playful sans-serif font. Overall look: bold, fun, sexy, queer, and defiant, perfect for Instagram and sex-positive spaces.
